name: ledger
description: busybox httpd + a CGI ledger; every acknowledged entry must be stored exactly once.

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  r=$(wget -q -T 2 -O- "http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/put?id=$i" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$r" = "OK $i" ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  else echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done
workload.retry:
for i in $(awk '{ o[$1] = $2 } END { for (i in o) if (o[i] != "ack") print i }' $HYDO_OUTCOMES | sort -n); do
  r=$(wget -q -T 2 -O- "http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/put?id=$i" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$r" = "OK $i" ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
done

invariants.msg: every entry the client saw acknowledged is stored exactly once
invariants.cmd:
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  n=$(grep -cx "$i" /data/ledger/entries)
  [ "$n" = 1 ] || { echo "entry $i stored $n times"; exit 1; }
done
echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) each stored once"

invariants.msg: no entry is ever stored twice
